name: @tishlang/tishdoc-render-html
description: TishDoc AST → semantic HTML + default print CSS

scripts.build: tish build --target js --no-optimize src/main.tish -o dist/tishdoc-render-html.js && TISH_EXPORT_OUT=dist/tishdoc-render-html.js TISH_EXPORT_NAMES=renderToHtmlFragment,renderToHtmlDocument,defaultPrintCss node scripts/append-exports.mjs
